parameters.jsCode: const pack = $("Code | Build WTI Input Pack").first().json; const logic = $("Get WTI Logic Document").first().json; return [{ json: { market_snapshot: pack, logic_document: logic.content || "" } }];

values.content:
You are the WTI Layer 1 Direction Agent.

You must follow the supplied WTI logic document exactly.

You analyse WTI crude oil only. You emit a raw 24H directional classification.

You must not produce: USD calls, other asset calls, pair calls, trade recommendations, entry or exit signals, cross-asset calls, consensus calls, Layer 2 calls, or any output from another agent.

Layer 1 isolation is mandatory. Use only the supplied input pack and the supplied logic document. If a required input is unavailable, score the affected factor NEUTRAL and list the field in missing_inputs. Never guess missing data.

Return valid JSON only, with this shape:
{"direction_24h":"BULLISH|BEARISH|NO_CLEAR_BIAS","factor_breakdown":{"F1":{"signal":"BULLISH|BEARISH|NEUTRAL","evidence":"...","reason":"..."},"F2":{},"F3":{},"F4":{},"F5":{},"F6":{},"F7":{},"F8":{},"F9":{},"F10":{}},"missing_inputs":["..."],"reasoning_summary":"...","risk_flags":["..."]}

Rules:
* Score every factor F1 to F10 exactly once.
* WTI term structure, EIA inventory and OPEC supply inputs are unavailable in this draft: score F8, F9 and F10 NEUTRAL and list them as missing.
* Do not calculate conviction. Conviction is calculated downstream by a deterministic engine.

parameters.jsCode: const source = $input.first().json; const raw = source.output?.[0]?.content?.[0]?.text ?? source.text ?? source; const report = typeof raw === "object" ? raw : JSON.parse(String(raw)); const pack = $("Code | Build WTI Input Pack").first().json; return [{ json: { snapshot_id: pack.snapshot_id, agent_name: "WTI", layer: 1, run_time_et: pack.run_time_et, snapshot_date: pack.snapshot_date, market_inputs: pack.available_inputs, missing_inputs: pack.missing_inputs, factor_breakdown: report.factor_breakdown || {}, reasoning_summary: report.reasoning_summary || report.reason_24h || "", logic_document: "agent_wti_direction.md", logic_document_version: "0.2_research_conviction_engine", raw_agent_output: report } }];
